scope: Focused passing regression tests for Table147 native settings seams. Assertions stop at actual GTK PrintSettings and the Qt Rust host bridge, not native dialogs or physical output.

source.locator: EC3-integrated primary PDF, printed pp.439–440 / physical pp.454–455.
rules_used: PrintScaling /None means no page scaling; AppDefault uses the processor's own default.
Duplex choices distinguish flip-short-edge and flip-long-edge; an absent setting has an implementation-dependent default.
PrintPageRange initializes the dialog from inclusive first/last pairs, using one-based page numbers.
NumCopies initializes the dialog to the stated number of copies; its absent default is implementation-dependent, typically one.
source.external_mapping_source: Official GTK4.18.6 CUPS backend: gtkprintbackendcups.c lines5867ff map DuplexTumble to vertical and DuplexNoTumble to horizontal; lines4294ff label NoTumble long edge and Tumble short edge. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GNOME/gtk/4.18.6/modules/printbackends/gtkprintbackendcups.c

test_gap: print_scaling_policy_current found source-visible transfer but no focused assertion at the returned native settings seam. Existing core and PrintDefaults tests establish parsing and generic values, not the GtkPrintSettings object or all QtPrintJob bridge fields.
residuals: No claim that either native dialog actually opens with these settings at runtime; no test here drives the dialog or a printer.
The source's tray-by-PDF-size setting is conditional on an OS capability, and the reviewed GTK/Qt paths expose no matching control. These drafts do not characterize a capable host.
The no-dialog C API's explicit placement versus the suppressed-dialog PrintScaling sentence remains outside this test shard.
